tools.title: Search campaign tracking stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate campaign tracking-statistics rows for a date range and optional campaign filters.

startDate.description: Start date for the analytics range. Use yyyy-MM-dd or an ISO 8601 date/time.

endDate.description: End date for the analytics range. Use yyyy-MM-dd or an ISO 8601 date/time.

moderateIds.description: Optional moderate IDs/campaign mailing IDs to filter.

reportSummaryIds.description: Optional report summary IDs to filter.

campaignIds.description: Optional campaign report group IDs to filter.

pageSize.description: Optional page size for paged TrackingStats results.

pageNumber.description: Optional page number for paged TrackingStats results.

listName.description: Optional Delivra listname/account override for this call.

tools.name: get_delivra_sms_analytics
tools.title: Get SMS analytics
tools.description: Returns SMS tracking stats, sends, or unsubscribe analytics.

startDate.description: Start date for date-range modes. Use yyyy-MM-dd or an ISO 8601 date/time.

endDate.description: End date for date-range modes. Use yyyy-MM-dd or an ISO 8601 date/time.

mailingId.description: Optional SMS mailing ID for trackingStats by mailing.

messageId.description: Optional SMS message ID for sends by message.

pageSize.description: Optional page size for paged SMS analytics results.

pageNumber.description: Optional page number for paged SMS analytics results.

listName.description: Optional Delivra listname/account override for this call.

tools.name: list_delivra_accounts
tools.title: List Delivra accounts
tools.description: Searches authorized Delivra accounts by listname, site name, or company name and returns one small page (20 by default, maximum 50). Do not enumerate all pages. An account missing from a page is not an access denial; use set_current_delivra_account for an exact known listname.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of the account listname, for example symsoft.

pageNumber.description: One-based page number. Request more pages only when needed.

pageSize.description: Accounts per page, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

siteName.description: Case-insensitive substring of the site name (Lists_.Topic_).

companyName.description: Case-insensitive substring of the company name (Customers_.CompanyName_).

expand.description: Optional comma-delimited fields to include in results: siteName,companyName.

tools.title: Get subscriber performance
tools.description: Returns subscriber performance sources, summary, breakdown, cohort, or drilldown rows.

mode.description: Mode: sources, summary, sourceBreakdown, cohortAnalysis, newSubscribers, unsubscribes, delivered, opens, uniqueOpens, clicks, uniqueClicks, or emailCampaignsSent.

endDate.description: End date for modes that require a range. Use yyyy-MM-dd or an ISO 8601 date/time.

sources.description: Subscriber source filters. Required for all modes except sources.

pageSize.description: Optional page size for paged subscriber performance modes.

pageNumber.description: Optional page number for paged subscriber performance modes.

listName.description: Optional Delivra listname/account override for this call.
